verdict.rationale: Lago's API reference states that every endpoint has a generated command. Its developers page shows copy-pasteable curl examples, and a published OpenAPI 3.1 schema (probe-confirmed) backs the reference. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' playground that runs requests. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser request runner or playground, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
